pre_e2e_required_fixes.system_status_refresh: PATCHED on feature/production-console-v1-1: System panel refreshes after session/state changes.
pre_e2e_required_fixes.drag_drop_candidate_intake: Drag-and-drop candidate intake failed during Local Mac Regression. File-picker upload path succeeded and exact-binary verification passed. Drag-and-drop must be fixed before formal E2E Qualification.
pre_e2e_required_fixes.work_handoff_ux: Production UX must not require Product Owner to manually download a Work Handoff JSON for every shot. Console should auto-generate and route/expose the verified handoff to Work; manual download remains optional diagnostic/export only.
pre_e2e_required_fixes.production_ui_density: Production mode should fit the operator's whole-process view on approximately one page. Show stage, safety state, blocker, immutable identity summary and next action by default; keep technical details under expandable Evidence/Audit. Qualification mode may expose full diagnostics for screenshots and debugging.
pre_e2e_required_fixes.candidate_upload_idempotency: Local Mac Regression produced two Drive files with the same Candidate filename/size during one Candidate intake interaction. Candidate upload must be idempotent and concurrency-safe: one Session + Candidate ID may create at most one Drive binary; duplicate/double requests must return the already-bound Candidate or fail closed without creating another file.
pre_e2e_required_fixes.true_external_recovery: Current UI auto-loads the last Session from browser localStorage and disables Session ID once loaded. Current Reconcile External Evidence endpoint still requires an existing local Session file. This proves restart persistence + external cross-check, but not recovery from loss of local Session state. Before formal E2E, add a Recover Session from External Evidence flow that can start from Session ID / remote qualification evidence and reconstruct the local Session from GitHub qualification records + Drive binary without relying on prior local JSON.
pre_e2e_required_fixes.reconcile_feedback: PATCHED on feature/production-console-v1-1: Reconcile now shows working/success/failure feedback and refreshes Evidence/System.
pre_e2e_required_fixes.local_time_display: PATCHED on feature/production-console-v1-1: backend audit timestamps remain UTC; UI history renders in browser local timezone.
pre_e2e_required_fixes.stale_localstorage_autoload: When browser localStorage remembers a Session whose local JSON no longer exists, startup auto-load currently shows 'Session 不存在'. Production UX should suppress the modal and offer/trigger External Recovery instead.
pre_e2e_required_fixes.external_recovery_no_evidence_message: If a Session has no remote qualification evidence yet, External Recovery should show a clear user-facing message such as: '无法恢复：该 Session 尚未建立 GitHub qualification evidence。请先完成 Publication，或确认 Session ID。' rather than a raw RuntimeError.
pre_e2e_required_fixes.recovery_fidelity: Before formal E2E, external recovery must either (A) preserve enough authoritative remote evidence to reconstruct Design Package + Preflight audit accurately, or (B) explicitly label those fields as 'not recoverable from current remote evidence' rather than misleading PENDING/empty values. Do not fabricate PASS details.
